article.body:
INTERACT: Research paper, not vehicle deployment

INTERACT is an autonomous-driving planning method described in an arXiv paper dated 28 September 2026; no operator, geography or deployment status beyond research is identified.  
The paper title identifies anchor-conditioned prediction and trust-region refinement, but the supplied record does not establish its sensor suite, geofence, road environment, speed limits or other operational-design-domain constraints.  
No safety evidence, including miles, disengagements, incidents or intervention requirements, is provided.  
The record identifies no regulatory approval, commercial fleet, customer or deployment plan, so this is research rather than a pilot, limited service or commercial operation.
